notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed freeze bug.
Fixed a bug that prevented the number of consecutive wins from expiring.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.0
notes.content:
New cards added
Modification of the effects of some cards
Implementation of practice with CPU
Implementation of card list
Displayed hints
Matching time display added
Report malicious users
Cards that cannot be discarded during the game cannot be selected for discard.
Fixed a freeze bug when using cards
Fixed a bug that the effect of a disability remained on the turn when the disability was discarded from the hand
Fixed a bug that prevented the player from pressing the "Exit" button
Fixed a bug in the upper UI during battle
Improved communication handling
Fixed display of inappropriate names
Added number of icons and emotes
